data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek words meli (honey) and andros (man), Melisandra means sweet one or honey for a woman. In Greek mythology, Melisande was a priestess and prophetess, revered for her divine insights. The name Melisandra carries the meaning “Honey, sweet one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Melisandra usually hope their child will grow to embody honey, sweet one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with a sweet and divine connection to the gods.
data.etymology: Melisandra belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Honey, sweet one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Melisandra total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
